caption: The video captures a wide, eye-level sunset view over a densely built city, with a dark silhouetted mountain ridge across the lower frame and a thin antenna pole rising left of center. Soft purple and pink cloud cover fills the sky, while a bright yellow-orange band glows low on the horizon toward the right, interrupted by a small dark cloud notch. The camera holds still, so the town rooftops remain fixed and all visible motion stays in the sky. The puffy clouds at the upper-left and the darker oval cloud at left-center drift and reshape very slowly. The glowing horizon band keeps its saturation as warmth spreads faintly upward, and a few tiny point lights dot the foreground. Cloud motion and light evolve continuously and gently, with no discrete event.
